method: Diagnostic clone of installed compiler. After all normal validation and native optimization passes, measure after two collections, then cumulatively release output, backend caches, backend h bodies, checked e bodies, parsed v bodies. Exit without emitting or executing a changed program. This is root-retention measurement, not a production patch or compiler correctness test. Differences attribute only objects exclusively retained by removed roots; these are post-GC live heap, not allocation-stack attribution or peak RSS.
